title: Ben Tziyon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mishnah at the end of Eduyot, and the Bartenura explains that he was a violent, strong-armed man.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Eduyot 8:7 names Ben Tziyon, and the whole Torat-Emet Bartenura paragraph on בן ציון explicitly calls him אינש אלימא ובעל זרוע. This supports the attributed description without importing the Mishnah’s other families or rulings.
